task_context: You are an expert evaluator in combinatorics and scientific computing. You are grading an AI agent that had to complete a code generation task: implement a reusable audit module for binary cyclically permutable constant-weight codebooks from the mounted CPCW-code source paper, run the visible candidate instances, and submit an importable module, answer.json, report, and self-tests. Exact schema and computational correctness are handled by check_programmatic.py; grade scientific grounding, implementation evidence, validation quality, and communication using the submitted artifacts as data.

text_deliverables.label: report (data)
text_deliverables.note: Agent report; use for source grounding, method explanation, results, and limitations.

text_deliverables.label: code (data)
text_deliverables.note: Verify implementation criteria against the submitted code, not just report prose.

text_deliverables.label: self-tests (data)
text_deliverables.note: Use only for rubric criteria about validation and self-testing evidence.

text_deliverables.note: Exact numeric correctness is owned by check_programmatic.py; judge interpretation and consistency here.
